purpose: Offline candidate screening and sealed final qualification; never live tuning
independent_unit: layout; all qualifying chronological fields must win; repetitions never count as maps
comparison: Best median end-to-end result among all six existing GPU plans, cold and warm separately
global_class: Complete fields at least 256*256 cells, propagation cap <=40
frontier_class: Complete fields at least 256*256 cells, seed_count <=max(1,cells/1000)
selectability: Existing dimensions/cap are cheap; frontier seed count requires separate cost evidence before admission; bounded minimum step must come from movement-profile preparation, never a new classification scan
integrated_gate: Required separately: stratified independent simulations, early/middle/late segments, 8 compute slots including owner, candidate removal measurably worsens runtime or publication waits beyond paired timing noise
inconclusive: Do not admit; never relax gates or redefine classes after final results
failures: Any oracle mismatch, timeout, missing case or device failure blocks qualification; retain every failure
exclusions: No timing outlier trimming; unavailable or incomplete runs are unqualified, not wins
final_freeze: Freeze protocol, corpus manifest and all source hashes before generating final inputs; consume each final campaign only once
bounded_class: Complete fields at least 256*256 cells, cap <=16*minimum entry step: at most 16 edges; single exact dependency-cone dispatch with 2/4/8/16 local steps sufficient for floor(cap/minimum_step)
